summary: Evaluate a local gyrotropic pressure diagnostic with an explicitly supplied fixed-flux derivative.

identity.relation: Anisotropic pressures and magnetic-field samples to two sampled margin criteria
identity.direction: (p_parallel, p_perp, B, mu0) -> firehose_margin, mirror_margin, minima and positivity flags
identity.definition: firehose_margin=B^2/mu0+p_perp-p_parallel. mirror_margin=B*d[p_perp+B^2/(2*mu0)]/dB at fixed psi = B^2/mu0+B*dp_perp_dB. Strictly positive sampled minima set the two local flags. For an invariant bi-Maxwellian this mirror criterion is 1-beta_perp*(T_perp/T_parallel-1)>0. Normal non-cancelling values retain ordinary float64 operation order. If opposing contributions leave at most half the magnitude of the largest term, or an intermediate product/quotient loses range, the same complete relation is evaluated as an exact binary-rational expression and rounded once to float64. This protects finite cancellation residuals without a zero clamp or an equal-pressure special case; genuinely unrepresentable final margins fail.
identity.model: Local gyrotropic no-flow tension and long-wavelength total-pressure-slope criteria. The positive derivative sign follows this definition and the kinetic bi-Maxwellian threshold; it conflicts with the literal opposite sign printed in Frank2509.17288v4 Eq6. No author-confirmed erratum is asserted.
identity.geometry: Explicit fixed-psi pressure law or caller-designated sample lines whose flux label is constant along field_axis.
identity.coordinates: Magnetic-field magnitude B at fixed flux label psi; arrays are never flattened and globally sorted to infer this partial derivative.
identity.boundary: An explicit derivative may be scalar, broadcastable array, or callable(B,psi). Alternatively supply field_axis and psi: B must be strictly monotone along each line, with at least two samples, and psi exactly constant along that axis. Constant-field data require explicit derivative information; no zero-derivative fallback exists.
assumptions: B is a positive magnitude in T and both pressures use Pa.
The caller supplies a true fixed-flux partial derivative or valid fixed-psi sampling geometry.
Finite differences have endpoint/sampling error; a successful numerical diagnostic is not a spatial force-balance or global-stability proof.

inputs.name: p_parallel
inputs.shape: nonempty scalar or array; exactly the same shape as p_perp and magnetic_field
inputs.constraints: Finite; negative values are not rejected.

inputs.name: p_perp
inputs.shape: exactly the same shape as p_parallel
inputs.constraints: Finite; negative values are not rejected.

inputs.name: magnetic_field
inputs.description: Positive magnetic-field magnitude at the pressure samples.
inputs.shape: exactly the same shape as p_parallel
inputs.constraints: Finite strictly positive values, same shape as pressures. Duplicate B values are allowed with an explicit derivative; sampled fixed-flux lines require strict monotonicity.

inputs.name: mu0
inputs.description: Magnetic permeability used in the B^2/mu0 terms.
inputs.constraints: Finite and strictly positive; the default is 4*pi*1e-7.

inputs.name: parallel_equilibrium
inputs.description: Optional upstream diagnostic dictionary; only error and max_relative_error fields are forwarded.
inputs.constraints: When present, must be a dict. The two forwarded values are not independently validated for shape, units or finiteness.

inputs.name: dp_perp_dB
inputs.shape: scalar/array broadcastable to B, callable(B,psi), or None
inputs.constraints: Required unless field_axis and psi are supplied; finite on evaluation. Cannot be combined with field_axis.

inputs.name: field_axis
inputs.description: Axis along which each sample line varies B while holding psi fixed.
inputs.constraints: With no explicit derivative, requires >=2 samples, strictly monotone B on every line, and constant psi along the axis.

inputs.name: psi
inputs.description: Flux labels for fixed-flux sample lines or explicit derivative callable.
inputs.constraints: Mandatory and finite for field_axis mode, exactly constant along that axis. Forwarded to a derivative callable otherwise.

outputs.name: mirror_margin
outputs.constraints: Finite local total-pressure-slope margin on successful return, not a general stability theorem.

outputs.name: firehose_stable
outputs.description: True exactly when every supplied firehose margin is strictly positive.
outputs.constraints: A sampled aggregate flag, not a spatially resolved stability field or sufficient physical stability theorem.

outputs.name: mirror_stable
outputs.description: True exactly when every supplied mirror margin is strictly positive.
outputs.constraints: A sampled aggregate flag, not a spatially resolved stability field or sufficient physical stability theorem.

outputs.name: min_firehose_margin
outputs.description: Minimum firehose margin across all samples.

outputs.name: min_mirror_margin
outputs.description: Minimum mirror margin across all samples.

outputs.name: parallel_equilibrium_error
outputs.description: Unmodified parallel_equilibrium.error value, or None when absent.
outputs.units: upstream-defined, normally Pa, or not applicable
outputs.constraints: No independent numeric, unit, shape or finite check.

outputs.name: max_parallel_equilibrium_error
outputs.description: Unmodified parallel_equilibrium.max_relative_error value, or None when absent.
outputs.units: upstream-defined, normally dimensionless, or not applicable
outputs.constraints: No independent numeric, unit or finite check.

outputs.name: dp_perp_dB
outputs.description: Fixed-psi derivative used by the diagnostic.

outputs.name: derivative_method
outputs.description: How the fixed-flux derivative was obtained.
outputs.constraints: Explicit derivative or fixed-psi axis finite difference.

outputs.name: criterion
outputs.description: Physical interpretation of the local diagnostic.

preconditions: Positive B with finite, shape-consistent pressure samples.
Explicit fixed-psi derivative or genuine constant-psi sample lines.
supported: Scalars and arbitrary sample layouts with an explicit derivative.
Monotone B sampling independently along each fixed-psi line; at least two samples per line.
excluded: Inferring a fixed-psi derivative from an unstructured spatial cloud or constant-B data alone.
General Hall-flow, finite-Larmor-radius, finite-wave-number or global stability conclusions.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError for missing derivative information, conflicting derivative/axis inputs, nonfinite or nonpositive B, invalid shapes or nonmonotone/variable-psi derivative lines; other documented scalar controls are validated.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: FloatingPointError when the final mathematical margin cannot be represented as finite float64; representable results are not rejected solely because an intermediate B square exceeds range. Other conversion/callback errors propagate.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: No nonlinear solve; the caller is responsible for derivative sampling convergence.
failure_semantics.partial_results: None. Optional upstream parallel-equilibrium values in the margin API are forwarded without independent validation.

python.signature: compute_firehose_mirror_margins(p_parallel, p_perp, magnetic_field, mu0=1.2566370614359173e-06, parallel_equilibrium=None, *, dp_perp_dB=None, field_axis=None, psi=None)

example.description: An explicit anisotropic bi-Maxwellian local state fails the mirror criterion but retains positive firehose tension.
example.code:
from scirel.diagnostics.firehose_mirror_margins import compute_firehose_mirror_margins
r=compute_firehose_mirror_margins(1.,2.,1.,mu0=1.,dp_perp_dB=-4.)
assert abs(float(r['firehose_margin'])-2.)<1e-12
assert abs(float(r['mirror_margin'])+3.)<1e-12
assert r['firehose_stable'] and not r['mirror_stable']
r=compute_firehose_mirror_margins(1e100,1e100,1.,mu0=1.,dp_perp_dB=0.)
assert float(r['firehose_margin'])==1. and r['firehose_stable']
example.expected: Firehose margin 2 and mirror margin -3; the derivative sign matches the explicit total-pressure derivative and kinetic threshold. Equal large pressures retain 1 Pa of magnetic tension and its strictly positive sampled flag.

scope: Explicit uniform-isotropic and fixed-psi multi-line polynomial regressions.
Sixty-three invariant bi-Maxwellian states cross-check pressure compatibility and total-pressure-slope threshold.
Four sample refinements demonstrate finite-difference convergence along fixed-psi lines.
Finite-input intermediate square overflow/underflow and cancellation are checked against an independent high-precision Decimal evaluation; genuinely unrepresentable final results still fail.

Finite equal and unequal-pressure cancellation, neighbouring binary64 inputs across dimensional scales, mirror residual signs, noncontiguous multidimensional arrays and exact-zero flags are checked against independent 2000-digit Decimal arithmetic in a no-source installed wheel.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Analytic identities, explicit failure regressions and independent numerical comparisons establish the stated mathematical contract. They do not establish measured-plasma validity or a general stability theorem.
known_limitations: The new derivative/axis/psi keywords require callers to supply missing physical information; old global-B-sort behavior is intentionally removed.
Sampled flags and residuals are local model diagnostics, not proof of global equilibrium or kinetic stability.
The literal Frank Eq6 sign conflict is recorded; this implementation follows the stated total-pressure derivative and bi-Maxwellian criterion rather than asserting an author erratum.
